meta.name: Kemuning Signature — Highland Eco-Adventure & Corporate Resort
meta.description: Three-dimensional Design DNA profile for JelajahKemuning.com combining lush Mount Lawu tea-plantation emerald tones, high-conversion terracotta adventure accents, real trip photography, glassmorphic surfaces, and interactive Canvas 2D highland mist particles.

primary.role: Deep Tea Emerald for brand authority, hero immersion, and primary headings

secondary.role: Fresh Highland Leaf Green for trust badges, checkmarks, and eco-adventure highlights

accent.role: Warm Terracotta / Sunrise Orange for high-converting WhatsApp CTAs, pricing highlights, and popular badges

neutral.usage: Lightest #F8FAF8 for main page canvas, #FFFFFF for elevated cards, #111C16 for primary body text, #64746B for secondary captions

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast dark-emerald hero & testimonial sections alternating with crisp warm-white content sections and vibrant terracotta action triggers

typography.font_style_notes: Geometric-humanist sans-serif ('Plus Jakarta Sans') giving both modern Indonesian travel-tech polish and warm approachability

spacing.section_rhythm: Generous 80px-96px vertical padding on desktop, 56px on mobile, separated by organic SVG highland wave dividers

layout.grid_system: CSS Grid 12-column & responsive auto-fit Bento cards
layout.alignment_tendency: Asymmetric split hero with centered section headers and 3-column bento package grids

shape.border_usage: Subtle 1px borders (#E2E8E4) on light cards and luminous 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.16) borders on glassmorphism layers

elevation.depth_cues: Overlapping photo collages, frosted glass badges over package thumbnails, and elevated featured pricing card

iconography.style: Duotone SVG & crisp rounded line icons
iconography.preferred_set: Custom inline SVG icons + semantic adventure badges

motion.entrance_pattern: Staggered fade-up (translateY 24px to 0) triggered via IntersectionObserver

components.button_style: Pill/rounded-md buttons with gradient terracotta fill, subtle inner highlight, icon prefix, and hover lift + glow
components.input_style: 12px rounded inputs with 1.5px border and emerald focus ring
components.card_style: 20px rounded photo-header cards with aspect-ratio 16/10 thumbnail, floating glass duration/badge pills, route timeline box, and sticky bottom CTA
components.navigation_pattern: Sticky frosted-glass navbar with official logo, category links, quiz badge, and pulse WhatsApp CTA
components.modal_style: Centered glass-backdrop lightbox for gallery photos and interactive quiz/proposal steps
components.list_style: Custom emerald checkmark pills with bold key inclusions
components.component_notes: Featured 'Paket Terlaris' card scales 1.03x on desktop with a glowing terracotta border and ribbon

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Morning sunlight breaking through misty Mount Lawu tea plantations before an offroad expedition
aesthetic.era_influence: 2026 Modern Boutique Travel & Outdoor Experience Platform

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Balanced breathing room around dense, scannable package facility lists
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Heavy visual anchor in Hero & 3 Bestseller Cards, followed by structured category showcases
visual_language.focal_strategy: Progressive reveal from Hero collage -> 3 Bestseller Packages -> Interactive Route & Category Explorer -> Social Proof
visual_language.contrast_level: High contrast between deep forest greens, crisp white cards, and fiery orange CTAs
visual_language.texture_usage: Subtle radial mesh glows, frosted glass overlays, and real outdoor adventure photography

composition.hierarchy_method: Scale contrast + color weight + photographic framing
composition.flow_direction: Z-pattern in hero transitioning to scannable 3-column bento grids
composition.grouping_strategy: Card enclosures with distinct header thumbnails, pricing bands, route boxes, and facility checklists
composition.negative_space_role: Separates distinct tourism activities (Jeep vs. Outbound vs. Tubing vs. Villa) for effortless comparison

imagery.photo_treatment: High-saturation real Kemuning trip photos with subtle bottom gradient scrims for badge legibility and zoom-on-hover
imagery.illustration_style: Organic SVG mountain & tea-leaf vector accents
imagery.graphic_elements: Floating NIB legal badges, route stop timeline pills, and 5-star Google review cards
imagery.pattern_usage: Subtle dot/topographic grid pattern in hero background

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate visual elevation (-6px translateY) and button shadow intensification
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Card lift, thumbnail 1.06x scale zoom, and CTA arrow translation
interaction_feel.loading_style: Instant SSR rendering with progressive scroll-reveal
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Moderate and purposeful — focused on package comparison, gallery filtering, and WhatsApp conversion

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: Friendly, enthusiastic local guide backed by formal CV corporate credibility
brand_voice_in_ui.formality: Semi-formal (casual-warm for families, structured and legal-ready with NIB & PDF proposals for corporate committees)
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: Direct action-oriented invitation ('Booking Cepat via WA', 'Unduh Proposal PDF Resmi')

background_effects.description: Layered radial emerald and warm sunlight mesh gradients behind the hero and CTA sections

particle_systems.description: Floating morning mist motes and golden sunlight particles drifting across the Kemuning highland hero section

params.movement_pattern: gentle upward and lateral drift with sine-wave oscillation
params.color_behavior: Warm gold (#FBBF24) and soft emerald mist (#A7F3D0) with pulsing alpha

3d_elements.description: Not used to preserve instant mobile load speed on shared hosting

text_effects.description: Golden-emerald gradient text highlight on key hero headline words

cursor_effects.description: Disabled as primary audience is mobile/tablet WhatsApp bookers

image_effects.description: Smooth 1.06x image scale zoom on card hover with gradient overlay reveal and interactive lightbox zoom

canvas_drawings.description: Hero Canvas 2D floating highland mist & sun-motes with mouse-repel physics

svg_animations.description: Layered SVG mountain/tea-plantation wave dividers and pulsing WhatsApp status indicator

visual_effects.composite_notes: Combines fast server-side rendered HTML with lightweight Canvas 2D atmospheric particles in the hero, real WebP trip photography on every card, category filter tabs on the homepage, and an interactive photo lightbox for the documentation gallery.
